name: VA medical centers serving Missouri
description: VA medical centers in Missouri: VA St. Louis Health Care System (314-652-4100); Kansas City VA Medical Center (816-861-4700); Harry S. Truman Memorial Veterans’ Hospital, Columbia (573-814-6000); John J. Pershing VA Medical Center, Poplar Bluff (573-686-4151). Some southwest and border counties are served by VA systems in Arkansas, Kansas or Illinois.
next_step: Use VA’s facility locator with your ZIP code to find the closest clinic and its medical center. Not enrolled yet? Call 877-222-8387 or ask your Veterans Service Officer for help applying.
constraints: VA does not publish county lists for these systems, so this card does not assign counties. Your VA care team may be at a different clinic or system; follow what VA tells you.
